memories.author: D06
memories.text: function: reports mild dizziness on turning head, no difficulty with ADLs. cognition: Mini-Cog 4/5 (recall 3, clock draw normal). falls: 0 falls in last 12 months, gait steady, TUG 10 seconds (normal). medicines: 5 regular (betahistine 16 mg BD, meclizine 25 mg SOS, apixaban 5 mg BD, bisoprolol 2.5 mg OD, warfarin 3 mg OD). mood: denies low mood or anxiety. carers: daughter Priya, lives nearby. goals: "I want to stay independent and continue my lab work."

memories.author: D06
memories.text:
betahistine 16 mg twice daily
meclizine 25 mg as needed for vertigo
apixaban 5 mg twice daily
bisoprolol 2.5 mg once daily
warfarin 3 mg once daily; target INR 2-3

memories.author: D06
memories.text: ECG: sinus rhythm, heart rate 78 bpm, no ST-T changes, PR interval 160 ms, QRS 92 ms. No atrial fibrillation noted at this moment; likely paroxysmal.

memories.author: D06
memories.text: Dix-Hallpike test: positive on right side with transient torsional nystagmus lasting <10 seconds, consistent with right posterior canal BPPV.

memories.author: D06
memories.text: Audiometry (pure tone average): bilateral mild high-frequency hearing loss (25 dB at 4 kHz), otherwise within normal limits; no significant asymmetry.

memories.author: lab
memories.text:
INR 2.4 (target 2-3)
Serum creatinine 0.9 mg/dL (eGFR >60)
TSH 2.1 mIU/L (reference 0.4-4.0)

memories.text: function: occasional vertigo episodes, now 1-2 per week, lasting <1 minute; ADLs unaffected. cognition: Mini-Cog 4/5. falls: 0 falls, gait slightly cautious, TUG 11 seconds (borderline). medicines: 5 regular. mood: reports frustration with dizziness, no depression. carers: daughter Priya. goals: "I want to reduce dizzy spells and keep working part-time."
